description: Search for hotels, restaurants, attractions, or activities to recommend to the traveler, returned as rich visual cards (image, rating, price level, link). Use this when the user wants suggestions or things to do/eat/stay near a place.

category.description: What to discover: hotels, restaurants, attractions, or activities.

latitude.description: Optional latitude to bias the search.

location.description: City or area to search in, such as "Madrid" or "Lisbon, Portugal". Provide this when latitude/longitude are unknown.

longitude.description: Optional longitude to bias the search.

max_results.description: Max cards to return, 1-10. Defaults to 8.

query.description: Optional refinement, such as "luxury", "family friendly", "tapas", or "museums".

name: discover
title: Discover travel options
